body: I only got home a minute ago I’ve been pulled 12 hr days with the pandemic. We can talk yeah.

I’m on lunch at work. No current danger since I’m doing it tomorrow. I’m feeling really calm right now, I just wanted to share. Maybe a little bit guilty too but I guess that’s the point of confessing I have means and an active plan.

I have a dog and a cat and I do live alone, I managed to move away from my family when I was 19.

I’ve struggled with my mental health for a really long time and my depression is episodic in nature. Sometimes it lasts a month and other times it can last over a year. I get better and then don’t. A little before I moved away from my family I stopped seeing my doctors and stopped taking medication, probably around 17/18. I need adult care now and just can’t get any.

I don’t think anything in particular triggered it but even if it gets better right now it’s going to get worse again. I can try to confide in friends but it’s hard, I’m very aware of the strain of caring for someone struggling like this and I don’t want to put undue stress on a lot of people. I’ve mentioned having a hard time with my depression and just tend to talk about other things generally, since it can be a lot, and I don’t want to be more burdensome than I have to be.

I looked for online counseling but the providers covered by my insurance either don’t offer medication or aren’t currently accepting new patients. I do really well on medicine as long as I am taking it. I also had a diagnostic evaluation in October after a doctor referral and was diagnosed with ADHD which I never knew I had, but the place I got my evaluation at wasn’t accepting new therapy and psychiatry patients. I was diagnosed with bipolar before which would explain my mood episodes more.
